submarket: HIDDEN MARKET — "HOW EXHAUSTED PARENTS DIVIDE THE NIGHT"

finding.headline: "The Chore-Robot (can't rest during baby's nap)"
finding.problem: "When my baby naps I clean, cook, pump. My mum says 'sleep!' but if I sleep the house falls apart and my husband notices nothing. I'm running on fumes and ashamed to admit I'm not coping."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "HOW EXHAUSTED PARENTS DIVIDE THE NIGHT"
finding.person: 27-yr-old Nigerian mum, baby naps 30 mins; she uses every nap to scrub, cook, pump — never actually rests; "resting feels like laziness."
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone" | cross-sells: Bonus "Rest Rota". Verdict: PASSES (5/5).
